prs.author: keurcien

(2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: After tokens are loaded from TokenStorage on startup, OAuthContext.token_expiry_time is never recomputed, so is_token_valid() treats an actually-expired stored token as valid, the proactive-refresh branch is skipped, and every expiry after a restart forces a full interactive re-authorization instead of a silent refresh (matches issue #1318, 'Prevents Proactive Refresh'). (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs target the exact root cause described verbatim in #2875's own added comment ('A provider reloaded from storage never restores token_expiry_time...'). #1784 fixes it at the source with a 4-line change in _initialize() (plus a new expired_tokens test fixture), which restores true proactive refresh — the behavior the linked issue title calls out. #2875 instead adds a ~15-line 'Step 3.5' fallback inside the 401 handler that only refreshes reactively after an unauthorized response; it does not fix is_token_valid()/proactive refresh at all, so even after merging, every restart still eats one extra unauthorized round trip before refreshing. prs.title: fix: skip JSON pre-parsing for str union annotations in pre_parse_json
prs.author: adityuhkapoor

prs.author: Dharit13

clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs solve cold-start refresh missing oauth_metadata. #2492 adds get_oauth_metadata/set_oauth_metadata to the TokenStorage protocol with no-op defaults — this only fixes the bug for storage backends that implement the two new optional methods, so out-of-the-box behavior for any existing TokenStorage implementation is unchanged. #3263 fixes it unconditionally for every backend by rediscovering AS metadata before the cold-start refresh call (gated by a new eager_discovery_attempted flag so it only probes once per process), and additionally verifies the rediscovered issuer matches the expected one — an issuer-binding check #2492's persisted-metadata path has no equivalent for. #3263 requires no TokenStorage interface change, so it doesn't require every downstream storage implementation to be updated to take effect.
